# Manatee {.unnumbered}

Download zipped file [here](https://github.com/tbep-tech/tbcmp-opportunities/raw/refs/heads/main/data/04_opportunities_maps/oppmap_shp.zip).

```{r}
#| include: false
library(leaflet)
library(here)
library(sf)

i_am("docs/oppmap_manatee.qmd")

source(here("R", "funcs.R"))

load(file = here('data', '01_inputs', 'tbcmp_cnt.RData'))
load(file = here('data', '04_opportunities_maps', 'oppmap_manatee.RData'))
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
oppmap_leaflet(oppmap_manatee, 'Manatee', tbcmp_cnt, simplify = 10)
```
Note: polygons have been simplified for web display.
